description: This file defines the NotificationProvider class which manages user notification preferences and system messages in a Flutter app. It interfaces with an API client for backend communication and extends ChangeNotifier for state management.

classes.name: NotificationProvider
classes.description: A ChangeNotifier that handles notification settings and messages, fetching data from a backend API and notifying listeners of changes.

methods.name: setOptIn
methods.description: Updates the user's push notification preference both locally and on the backend.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Loads notifications and system messages from the backend.
